title: Built a chrome extension with opus in 3 hours by which you can destroy websites
author: pop6996pop
selftext:
Link: [domolition.chirkut.xyz](https://domolition.chirkut.xyz) (demo plays right on the site, no install needed)



Saw [destroy.spritefusion.com](http://destroy.spritefusion.com) here and wanted it as a Chrome extension, so it works on whatever page I'm already on, even logged in stuff like X, Gmail or Jira. Built it with Claude Code in a few days, added 8 guns incl. a nuke.

comments.author: xXApolloXx3825
comments.body: this is the coolest thing ive ever seen lol. i love it

replies.author: xXApolloXx3825
replies.body: you made it paid? i feel like you shouldn't have to pay for something like this. plus, you can just use spritefusion for free :/

replies.author: pop6996pop
replies.body: Thanks for your feedback, I made it free in the new version, its in review. Hoping to get positive reviews from you. Will update once published in the chrome store.

replies.author: pop6996pop
replies.body: Btw its free now, also introducing multiplayer, hope u will like it

replies.author: xXApolloXx3825
replies.body: love it! especially swapping the weapons with your number keys. Also how do I play multiplayer, i dont see an option for it...

replies.body: There was a issue so it wasnt published, will drop a cmmnt. Sorry for the delay :(
